description_en: Modifies the error code redirect configuration
description_zh: 修改错误码重定向配置
name: UpdateErrorPagesRedirectRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You do not need to specify this parameter when adding a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. You do not need to specify this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content, which uses conditional expressions to match user requests. You do not need to specify this parameter when adding a global configuration. This parameter applies to the following scenarios:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

fields.help_en:
The response status code used by the node when responding to the client with a redirect address. Valid values:

400
403
404
405
414
416
500
501
502
503
504
fields.help_zh:
节点给客户端响应重定向地址时候使用的响应状态码。取值范围：

400
403
404
405
414
416
500
501
502
503
504
fields.name: status_code

fields.help_en: The target URL after the redirect
fields.name: target_url

parameters.help_en: The execution sequence of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
